messages:
marie: Quick readiness check — planning to cut v2.5.0 tomorrow morning. Can we lock CI baseline by EOD? Windows tests have been flapping.

alex: I'm running a focused sweep now. Seen failures in `tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::TestLRU` on windows-2022. Reproduced locally once.

jamal: @alex thx. I'll prioritize flaky triage. Can you paste the failing traceback?

alex: Sure, here's the tail: ```Traceback (most recent call last): File ".../test_kv_cache.py", line 78, in test_lru AssertionError: expected 3 but got 2``` Appears timing related.

rachel: FYI smoke runs on linux/darwin are green. Windows queue is backlogged, so reruns are pending :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: CI: windows-lru-test failed on build 3872 — rerun queued by @alex.

jamal: I'll add a short retry decorator and run 5x locally to quantify flakiness. If >30% fail rate, we should block.

leyla: Changelog nudge: If we end up postponing, update CHANGELOG.md and ping release notes owners — I can help.

marie: @jamal thanks. Also quick governance Q: do we have a soft cutoff at 9am PT tomorrow? If tests unstable, we hold release and move to patch.

alex: Soft cutoff acknowledged. I'll post a final CI status update at 8:30am PT in this thread.

jamal: Ran 10 repeats: 2 failures (20%). Reproduced with `--max-workers=1` too. Suspect shared tmp dir race.

rachel: Can we try enabling `--use-tmpdir-isolation` flag in test runner? I'll spin a job.

ci-bot: CI: windows job 3876 started with `--use-tmpdir-isolation`.

alex: Job 3876 green on repeated runs (10/10). Seems isolation helped. I'll open a tiny PR with the flag and retry policy + backfill flaky test ticket.

marie: Great. Please link PR here. If merged before cutoff, proceed with release. :rocket: 

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6203 — adds isolation flag and retry decorator.

leyla: I'll update CHANGELOG.md entry draft and add a note about flaky test mitigation.

marie: Thanks team. Closing loop — final check at 8:30am PT tomorrow. If anything new pops up, ping in #eng-releases.
